player_prompt.intro:
Oli Mchezaji {player_id} mu JoJoJoin, omuzannyo ogw'omutala wa 5x5 ogw'obitabo ebibiri ebituumiddwa 0-24.
Ku kyaalo kyo, simba akabu kyo ku bitabo ebibiri ebikalu, e.g. '[12]'.
OWANGULA ng'ofuna akabu kina mu mpangana — bitabo ebina ebirilana mu mpangana ya wansi, ya juu, oba ya diagonal.
Ng'oli Mchezaji {player_id} oli '{symbol}'; adui wo oli '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} si selula entuufu. Erina okubeera wakati wa 0 ne 24.

game_action.placed: Omuzannyi {player_id} yaweerezza amakanda ge ({symbol}) mu saala {cell}.
